meta.title: Grammar Sweeper: what it needs and where it comes from
meta.subtitle: What grammar-sweeper-setup.exe carries, what it downloads from PyPI, and what you must already have

cards.title: Ships in grammar-sweeper-setup.exe (11.5 MB)
items: Inno Setup wizard: per-user install, no administrator rights
Program bundle, 21.7 MB installed: Python 3.14.5 runtime, pywin32 311, uiautomation 2.0.29, comtypes 1.4.17
The pinned SHA-256 hashes and the list of 149 files to keep

cards.title: Downloaded from PyPI during setup
items: PySide6_Essentials 6.11.2, 76,913,043 bytes: Qt, which draws the window (QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets)
shiboken6 6.11.2, 1,226,578 bytes: the bridge between Python and Qt
Pillow 12.2.0, 7,217,400 bytes: draws the logo and the background texture
Qt is LGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only; Pillow is MIT-CMU
Each file is checked against a pinned SHA-256 before it is unpacked; only 149 files are kept
If a download fails, setup stops and installs nothing

cards.title: You must already have
items: 64-bit Windows; an administrator account is not needed
Desktop Microsoft Word
Grammarly's add-in installed in Word and signed in, with its panel open
An internet connection while setup runs, and not afterwards

cards.title: You do not need
items: Python, pip or a compiler
Qt, PySide6 or Pillow installed separately
Administrator rights
Assessed: the Visual C++ runtime files come with the bundle and the Qt download

cards.title: Good to know
items: grammar-sweeper-setup.exe is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run
Setup contacts only PyPI, for the three downloads above
Uninstalling removes the program and the downloaded runtime folder
